Name: Stardew Springs
Author: Suvo
Description:
[size=3]Hey this is my first map so I'm open to criticism/suggestions[/size]

[size=4]Features:[/size]
[size=3]Grass that is diggable
More secluded area for grandpappys' shrine
Lots of farming space
A dock that you can swim at
A proper backyard
Space in the forest behind the yard for silos/obelisks[/size]

[size=4]Requirements:[/size]
[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1140/?]Custom Farm Types[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348/?]Spacecore[/url]

[size=4]How to install:[/size]
[size=3]Drag the contents into the Stardew Valley directory, usually located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley

To load the map in game choose the custom farm type "Stardew Springs" by scrolling down on the different farm types

[/size][size=4]Credits:
[/size][size=3][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/maleha.626319/]Maleha[/url] made the amazing waterfall tilesheets[/size]
